requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity, scan workflow, and manageability solutions into the Magellan printer to simplify business management for SMBs, both now and in the future.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require easy-to-use, efficient solutions due to lack of dedicated IT staff. AI features differentiate HP in the market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features for productivity, scan workflow, and manageability are available and functional in the released product; validated with at least 3 SMB customer use cases.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO for SMB Segment
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan delivers the lowest total cost of ownership (TCO) in HP's business printer lineup, specifically targeting SMB usage patterns.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a key decision factor for SMBs and a major competitive differentiator.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent TCO analysis confirms Magellan has the lowest business TCO among HP SMB printers and is competitive with leading rivals.

requirements.Title: High Serviceability and Customer Replaceable Components
requirements.Description: Design Magellan with a warranty of 80k pages or 2 years (whichever comes first) and ensure critical components (e.g., PHA, maintenance box) are customer replaceable or easily serviced at a service center.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack IT staff; reducing downtime and simplifying maintenance is critical.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components such as PHA and maintenance box can be replaced by customer or at service center within 30 minutes; warranty terms are clearly documented.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refilling
requirements.Description: Implement keyed bottles for ink refilling to prevent incorrect ink usage and improve user experience.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user error and service incidents, improving reliability and customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All ink bottles are uniquely keyed and only fit the correct tank; tested with 10+ end users for error prevention.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL and PDL SKU Feature Differentiation
requirements.Description: Offer both Non-PDL and PDL SKUs with distinct features: Non-PDL supports SMB2.0 Solutions, Advanced View SMB portal, and PaaS; PDL SKU offers improved speed (25/20ppm), PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses varying SMB needs and regulatory requirements, supports broader market coverage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Both SKUs available at launch with listed features; PDL SKU meets Blue Angel standards and speed targets.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Printer Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal tailored for SMBs to manage multiple printers, monitor status, and access AI solutions for print, scan, and support.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs need simple, centralized management to reduce IT overhead.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal supports management of at least 15 printers per SMB, includes AI features, and is rated 'easy to use' by at least 80% of pilot users.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan' AI-driven features for optimal print and scan quality, error detection, and workflow automation.
requirements.Rationale: Improves productivity and output quality, addresses top customer needs and pain points.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features reduce print/scan errors by 50% and improve workflow speed by 30% in SMB pilot tests.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Manufacture Magellan with at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and aligns with HP's environmental goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Material composition verified by 3rd party audit; marketing claims substantiated.

requirements.Title: Maintenance-Free or Reduced Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Engineer Magellan for maintenance-free or significantly reduced maintenance over its operational life, with fewer parts to replace.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces SMB operational burden and downtime; key customer pain point.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer requires 30% fewer maintenance interventions over 2 years compared to HP OJ Pro; validated in field trials.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Support mobile printing and seamless integration with the HP App for setup, usage, and support.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs increasingly require mobile workflows and easy setup for non-IT users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is fully functional with HP App on iOS/Android; 95% of setup tasks can be completed via app.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Magellan must support HP's PaaS offerings for SMBs, enabling service-based business models and future solution enhancements.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP's strategic goals for recurring revenue and solution monetization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is compatible with HP's SMB PaaS platform at launch; validated with 2 pilot customers.

requirements.Title: Telemetry and Advanced Analytics
requirements.Description: Include telemetry features to enable remote monitoring, diagnostics, and usage analytics for both HP and customers.
requirements.Rationale: Supports proactive support, product improvements, and customer manageability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is accessible via SMB portal and HP internal tools; at least 5 key metrics available.
